source_scope: Rows 3-10 of the author-supplied aggregate workbook
derivation: Hallucination rate = Incorrect / (Incorrect + Partial + Not_attempted). The displayed percentage is the rate multiplied by 100 and rounded to the nearest whole percent.
notes: The source workbook is maintained outside this repository. This frozen table contains only aggregate counts and derived rates needed to reproduce Supplementary Fig. 19b; it contains no prompts, responses, or credentials.
